tasks.title: Implement inert derive, show and diff across files and trees
tasks.goal: Materialize local derivative results with complete resource membership and byte-preserving data handling.
steps: Implement full replacement/local-source copy for each family in M-10-A using admitted captured inputs and retained local source.
Validate tree paths/membership before staged publication; preserve XML-data/opaque bytes and notices without running embedded content.
Expose show/diff through the owning service with raw/projection basis, exact digests and complete file additions/removals.
positive_cases: CommonMark, XML-data, Vibe-spec, opaque file and nested tree each produce a usable independently owned result.
Removing generated output permits recreation from retained authored input.
negative_cases: Traversal, changed base/local bytes, missing resource and duplicate path fail before publication.

tasks.title: Implement explicit rebase and guarded authored apply
tasks.goal: Preserve old provenance while rebasing a local derivative onto a newly selected base.
steps: Compare old base/new base/local content and return rebase-required with reviewable changes; do not auto-merge.
After explicit selection, recapture saved source and apply a new binding under M-16 edit barrier/CAS with retained before-state.
Journal local binding/result publication, preserve old accepted provenance and implement inspect/recover for interruption.
positive_cases: An explicit compatible rebase creates new provenance while preserving the prior chain.
Replay of an already-applied exact transaction is idempotent.
negative_cases: Missing old capture, ambiguous patch, dirty buffer or concurrent edit refuses.
Unknown third state remains recovery-required rather than overwriting local work.
